label: Equal high (3, 0.1 ATR)
gloss: whether this bar recorded a pivot high of length 3 within 0.1 × ATR(200) of the previous recorded one — computed by the server over this timeframe’s bars, LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts v7.0’s legs: a pivot high of length n is a high above every high of the n bars after it, a pivot low a low below every low of the n bars after it, recorded alternately as the leg turns; false on a bar that records no such pivot, absent until the bars read hold the ATR’s 800-bar window and a proven previous pivot

equalBars.description: The equal highs and lows’ pivot length, each side (LuxAlgo’s Bars Confirmation).

equalThreshold.description: How close two pivots must be to be equal, as a fraction of ATR(200) at the deciding bar.

label: Equal-high level (3, 0.1 ATR)
gloss: the price of the latest recorded pivot high of length 3 while it read equal — within 0.1 × ATR(200) of the previous recorded one, the newer end of LuxAlgo's EQH line — held until the next recorded pivot high of that length; no close retires it — computed by the server over this timeframe’s bars, LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts v7.0’s legs: a pivot high of length n is a high above every high of the n bars after it, a pivot low a low below every low of the n bars after it, recorded alternately as the leg turns; false on a bar that records no such pivot, absent until the bars read hold the ATR’s 800-bar window and a proven previous pivot

equalThreshold.description: How close two pivots must be to be equal, as a fraction of ATR(200) at the deciding bar.

label: Flow alignment
gloss: agreement between order flow and crowd positioning — aligned bullish when CVD_state is bullish and upLeanZ is at least 1.96; aligned bearish when CVD_state is bearish and upLeanZ is at most −1.96; divergent when CVD_state is bullish and upLeanZ is at most −1.96, or bearish and upLeanZ is at least 1.96; neutral otherwise; compared on the unrounded score; no value when either is absent

label: Funding annualized
gloss: the funding rate annualized (%), a point-in-time read at its own sample time

label: Funding label
gloss: the funding-pressure band over a point-in-time rate read at its own sample time

label: Funding rate
gloss: the perpetual funding rate (%), a point-in-time read at its own sample time

label: Gap
gloss: whether the bar opened outside the prior bar's range: up above its high, down below its low

label: Gap %
gloss: the gap from the prior bar's close to this bar's open, ((open − prior close) / prior close) × 100

label: Gap (range clear)
gloss: whether the bar's whole range cleared the prior bar's, TradingView's Gap Detector rule: up when its low is above the prior high, down when its high is below the prior low

label: High price
gloss: the bar's high price

label: Bar high vs open
gloss: how far the bar's high has run above its own open, ((high − open) / open) × 100 — never negative

label: Median price (HL2)
gloss: the bar's median price, (high + low) / 2

label: Typical price (HLC3)
gloss: the bar's typical price, (high + low + close) / 3
